brief_inputs.primary_decision: Whether measurement and assignment fidelity justify designing a later powered, single-factor creative experiment
brief_inputs.minimum_effect_worth_acting_on: 0.50 absolute percentage points in completed-purchase rate, an owner-selected fixture choice

produced_output.hypothesis: The account and measurement setup can preserve one creative label, exposure records, and completed-purchase records well enough to estimate a baseline for a later test.
produced_output.primary_decision: Proceed to a powered single-factor creative efficacy design only if assignment and measurement fidelity are demonstrated and a baseline estimate is usable.

minimum_effect_worth_acting_on.use: future power planning only, not a current benchmark

assignment.intended_allocation: single approved creative during this feasibility pilot; a later 1:1 allocation requires a valid observed assignment method
assignment.fallback: If no valid assignment method is observed, run a single-creative measurement feasibility pilot and make no comparative causal claim. Alternating dates or before-after performance is observational.

treatment_and_control.future_pair_requirement: Derive a pair that differs in one declared factor while holding audience, offer, destination, body, call to action, asset, timing, and measurement constant wherever the platform permits.
treatment_and_control.comparison_activation: blocked; the two current concepts change multiple elements and are not an isolated test pair

sample_and_power.reason: Baseline purchase rate, variance, eligible traffic, and assignment capability are absent. A numeric sample requirement would be spurious.

early_stop_conditions: Any account, policy, destination, or measurement integrity incident
Any material mismatch between creative labels and observed delivery records
Owner review at USD 65.60 comparable matured spend with zero completed purchases
fixed_feasibility_window.efficacy_stopping_rule: none; this pilot cannot adopt or reject a creative based on performance

pre_registered_outputs: Count of records with the single approved feasibility creative label
Count and rate of duplicated or unmatched conversion event IDs if two measurement paths are later used
Observed purchase-rate estimate with its denominator and uncertainty, for future design only
Measurement fidelity and the observed availability or absence of a future comparative assignment method
produced_output.repeated_looks_and_multiplicity: Operational integrity may be checked daily, but no efficacy decision is allowed. No comparative test occurs in the pilot. A later powered design must pre-register its look schedule and comparison count.
produced_output.causal_limitations: No treatment assignment exists yet. Any before-after, alternating-date, or nonrandom delivery comparison would remain observational and vulnerable to delivery, time, audience, and measurement differences.
produced_output.reasoning: The missing baseline does not prevent a bounded instrumentation pilot, but it prevents sample-size arithmetic and any credible adoption rule. The design protects the later decision by refusing to treat a 14-day spend window as statistical power.

findings.observation: A fixed 14-day, USD 840.00 maximum instrumentation pilot can test data fidelity, but it cannot decide creative efficacy.
No sample requirement is calculated because baseline rate, variance, eligible traffic, and assignment capability are missing.
Comparative interpretation remains blocked until a valid assignment method and implementation-fidelity evidence exist.

missing_inputs: Observed account-supported assignment or randomization method
Variance or enough raw data to estimate it
Expected eligible traffic and measurement lag

actions.action: Verify assignment capability and measurement fidelity, then run only the fixed feasibility pilot unless defensible baseline inputs support a separately reviewed power calculation.
actions.window: after readiness, creative, and measurement gates resolve
actions.success_measure: Assignment and event fidelity are measured, and any later power calculation cites the observed baseline and declared assumptions.
